narrative.overview: Everything is a card you could hold. Cream index-card stock sits on a warm paper ground; at night the ground goes charcoal and the cards warm grey. Tomato red is the brand and every primary action; herb green only ever means done, in the pantry, in the cart. The food photo leads each card, a serif name sits under it, and measured amounts are typed in Courier Prime like a card from a recipe box.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and cream card, never white or grey
One action colour (tomato), one status colour (herb); amber is a quiet warning only
Young Serif for names and headings, system UI for reading, Courier Prime for quantities
Photos carry the cards; a tomato-tint serif initial stands in when there is none
Drawn 1.75px-stroke 24px icons, no emoji or glyph icons
Surfaces separate by soft warm shadow and tonal steps, not by borders

rules.name: The Red Means Do Rule
rules.body: Tomato marks what to tap or what you chose; green marks what is finished. A screen never uses green for a button the user hasn't done yet, or tomato for a finished state.

rules.name: The Cream Not White Rule
rules.body: No pure white or black on the page. Text on photos sits on a cream pill, never bare.

rules.name: The Typed Amounts Rule
rules.body: Courier Prime is for measured amounts and timers only. Never for names, prose or labels.

rules.name: The Serif For Names Rule
rules.body: Anything the user would call a dish, a day, a store or a section is Young Serif; actions and metadata are system UI.

rules.name: The Flat Until Held Rule
rules.body: Cards rest on the soft Card shadow; only things that float over content (sheet, toast, timer pill) use the Overlay shadow.

dos: Do put the food photo first on any card that has one; fall back to a tomato-soft tile with the serif initial.
Do use tomato for actions and selection, herb for done, in the pantry and in the cart, and amber only for warnings.
Do set quantities in Courier Prime and names in Young Serif.
Do keep every tap target at 44px or more and give destructive swipes an undo toast.
Do use the drawn icon set (ICONS in core.js, 24px viewBox, 1.75px round stroke, currentColor).
Do define every new colour as a light and a dark token pair on :root.
donts: Don't use pure white, pure black or cool greys on the page; the ground is paper.
Don't use green for a button the user hasn't acted on, or red for a finished state.
Don't use Courier Prime for prose or labels.
Don't add gingham, stickers, handwriting fonts or decorative borders around cards.
Don't put bare text on photos; use the cream slot pill.
Don't use emoji or glyph characters as icons.
Don't build a seven-day grid of rows with inline inputs; one day at a time, one card per meal.
